Home Office Wall Art

A piece over the desk is the one you look up at between tasks. These pieces hold the eye without asking for all of it.

Hanging tip. Over a desk, hang the centre of the art at about eye level when you are standing, around 57 to 60 inches from the floor. Press “See it in this room” on any piece below to hang it in the room above, at real size.
